no_go_conditions: Any missing scenario or failed model-driven action
A successful file mutation in the Ask-mode policy scenario
A memory marker that cannot be found after restarting the daemon
A primary-provider failure without a recorded successful fallback
A scheduled task that cannot be paused, resumed, completed, and cancelled
interpretation: This file defines acceptance thresholds and stores per-model measured baselines. A baseline is added only after a clean committed revision passes all scenarios. Later runs must match the same hardware and pass each scenario without exceeding the absolute limit or 2x the measured latency plus 5 seconds. A passing mock-ci run never substitutes for this profile.
